title: Jade Willow Village
description: Whitewashed homes, crooked lanes and waterside gardens in an original southern-Chinese-inspired village pack.

provenance.sourceNote: Captured from the reviewed Jade Willow 1.4 devtools executable. The binary and full native replay evidence are frozen in the local cache; unrelated source edits after its build are not attributed to these pictures.

shots.title: A village in the autumn woods
shots.description: The nearest naturally placed Jade Willow village on the reference seed, surrounded by autumn woodland. Visit X 36, Z 380 with the pack enabled.

shots.title: Along the crooked lanes
shots.description: Staggered homes, branching lanes and small garden courts form an open settlement around the central square.

shots.title: A sheltered courtyard
shots.description: White plaster fire walls frame a two-wing household, a tiled veranda and a flowering tree.

shots.title: The tea-house gallery
shots.description: A timber street gallery and an external stair connect the two floors of the tea house.

shots.title: At the cottage door
shots.description: Paper lattice windows, brick plinths and timber thresholds open onto a narrow paved lane.

shots.title: Across the lotus pond
shots.description: A stepped stone footbridge crosses the curved basin beside willows, bamboo and the irrigation channel.

shots.title: The waterside quarter
shots.description: The pond and planted edges interrupt the village outline; gardens and working yards sit between the houses.

shots.title: Inside the tea room
shots.description: Low tea tables and stools furnish the upper room beside timber-framed paper screens.

shots.title: Steps to the granary
shots.description: Half-metre timber steps and side rails lead into the raised grain store.

shots.title: When the lanterns glow
shots.description: Warm hanging lanterns light the well square and the three-tier pavilion as the sky turns to evening.

shots.title: The courtyard house
shots.description: Two plaster wings frame a sheltered household court, with timber trim and a flowering tree.

shots.title: The tea house
shots.description: A two-storey tea room opens onto its timber gallery and the lane below.

shots.title: The elder residence
shots.description: Unequal house wings and a covered porch make a sheltered entrance for the village elder.

shots.title: The weaver's house
shots.description: A compact plaster home shares its work court with a timber loom and hanging cloth.

shots.title: The herbalist's cottage
shots.description: A low gabled cottage keeps herb planters and a small drying shed beside the door.

shots.title: Lane house · gabled
shots.description: A stepped plaster gable and brick threshold mark one of the village's smaller homes.

shots.title: Lane house · tall east
shots.description: The taller east-lane house keeps a narrow doorway beneath layered blue roof tiles.

shots.title: Lane house · east hearth
shots.description: A home hearth opens onto the east lane beside planted stone troughs.

shots.title: Lane house · north awning
shots.description: A timber awning shades the north approach while leaving the passage open.

shots.title: Lane house · tall west
shots.description: A narrow west-lane frontage rises behind a half-metre tiled eave.

shots.title: Lane house · east awning
shots.description: The east awning shelters a tight turn where two crooked lanes meet.

shots.title: Lane house · west hearth
shots.description: A plaster hearth wall and raised brick base face the western lane.

shots.title: Lane house · tall south
shots.description: A tall southern façade balances a narrow doorway with a broad tiled roof.

shots.title: Lane house · south awning
shots.description: Timber side posts hold a low awning over the southern lane entrance.

shots.title: Lane house · west hearth II
shots.description: A second hearth-front cottage shows the varied roof and porch rhythm along the lanes.

shots.title: The kiln workyard
shots.description: The brick kiln and covered work bay sit behind an open yard for making and firing pots.

shots.title: The raised granary
shots.description: A raised store keeps grain above ground level behind a sheltered loading entrance.

shots.title: The livestock shelter
shots.description: An open timber shelter stands inside the village paddock beside its red gate rails.

shots.title: Cloth stall
shots.description: A shaded market counter displays folded cloth beneath a tiled canopy.

shots.title: Produce stall
shots.description: Fresh greens and baskets fill a small produce counter along the central market lane.

shots.title: Pottery stall
shots.description: Clay vessels and a low counter give the pottery stall its own market frontage.

shots.title: Tea stall
shots.description: A compact tea counter faces the market's meeting of stone-paved paths.

shots.title: The covered village well
shots.description: A timber well canopy and shared seating anchor the paved village square.

shots.title: The three-tier pagoda
shots.description: Three compact tiled roofs rise above the domestic houses as a village landmark.

shots.title: The ancestral pavilion
shots.description: An open timber pavilion shelters a modest altar and seats beside the square.

shots.title: The opera stage
shots.description: An open-front timber stage faces the square beneath a broad hipped roof.

shots.title: The moon gate
shots.description: A rounded stone opening joins the lane to the gardens without enclosing another square.

shots.title: The entrance gate
shots.description: Lacquer-red timber frames the village entrance and the planted path beyond.

shots.title: Meet the village residents
shots.description: One of twelve original resident designs in the living village. Each generated settlement receives a different seeded group of six neutral wandering residents.
